name: Gurubashi Arena
summary: Gurubashi Arena is an ancient stone colosseum standing in southern Stranglethorn Vale, originally built by the mighty Gurubashi Empire. In the present day, it serves as a chaotic free-for-all proving ground where pirates and wandering brawlers shed blood over locked chests of treasure.

sections.title: A Legacy of Blood
sections.body: Long before human or orc set foot in Stranglethorn Vale, the Gurubashi Arena—known also as the Great Arena—was built as a monument to martial strength by the sprawling Gurubashi troll empire. In ancient days, champions fought to the death upon its sands until the earth was slick with troll blood.

sections.title: The Booty Run
sections.body: Though the empire has long since fractured into warring tribes, the arena's floor never stays clean for long. Today, lawless buccaneers and ruffians oversee a different sort of bloody spectacle. A pirate named Short John Mithril oversees the grounds, where every few hours a chest of plundered booty is hauled into the center of the ring. Anyone who steps onto the floor is fair game—faction allegiances vanish, and combatants must butcher their way to the prize against all comers.

faq.answer: It was constructed centuries ago by the Gurubashi Empire when they ruled the southern regions of the Eastern Kingdoms. It was designed as an enormous stadium for lethal trials of combat and ancient troll rituals honoring the loa.

faq.q: Why do people fight here now?
faq.answer: Local pirates use the arena for illicit entertainment. Every few hours, a pirate captain drags a treasure chest into the center of the sands, prompting a bloody free-for-all brawl among anyone daring enough to step into the ring and claim it.
Short John Mithril is a pirate who oversees the arena and the regular chest deliveries. He rewards combatants who consistently survive the chaotic brawls and recover his arena treasures.

faq.q: Why can members of my own faction attack me here?
aliases: why is gurubashi free for all
faq.answer: The floor of the arena operates under complete lawlessness. Once you cross onto the sands, all faction treaties and military alliances are suspended—only those standing together in your immediate battle party are spared your blade.

angles.text: For trolls, the arena is sacred ground rather than simple pirate sport, a monument of the old Gurubashi Empire where champions once shed blood upon the sands.
The sands offer one of the purest martial crucibles in Azeroth, stripped bare of grand war politics and reduced entirely to personal grit and raw survival.
